mechanics.claim: Kai'Sa's basic attacks apply 1 Plasma stack on-hit, and Void Seeker applies 2 stacks (3 if evolved).
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks each apply 1 stack and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' applies 2 stacks, increased to 3 if it is {{ai|Void Seeker 2|Kai'Sa|evolved}}.

mechanics.claim: Each Plasma application deals the base plus per-stack Caustic Wounds magic damage; a fresh application refreshes the 4-second duration rather than stacking a new timer per stack.
mechanics.quote: '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attacks or ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' deal {{as|{{pplevel|4 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} plus {{as|{{pplevel|1 to 8}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{as|per Plasma stack before application|buzzword}}

mechanics.claim: The 5th Plasma stack consumes all stacks and deals the missing-health detonation damage instead of another stack application.
mechanics.quote: The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}}

mechanics.claim: The missing-health detonation damage is evaluated after the initial Caustic Wounds damage and after Void Seeker's own damage if it triggered the detonation, but before a triggering basic attack's damage.
mechanics.quote: The bonus missing health damage is evaluated after the initial damage from ''Caustic Wounds'' is evaluated, and after {{ais|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}} damage if triggered by it, but before a triggering basic attack's is.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks the Plasma application from Void Seeker, not from basic attacks.

mechanics.claim: If Void Seeker detonates Plasma, any remaining stacks beyond the detonation are reapplied afterward, and Void Seeker's own damage is calculated as if each stack were applied successively.
mechanics.quote: With {{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}, if the stacks detonate {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}, any remaining stacks are reapplied afterwards. {{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}} also deals ''Caustic Wounds' ''damage based on {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} stacks on the target. This damage is calculated as if each stack was applied successively.

values.binNote: No calculation row directly outputs the per-missile reduced value; it is BaseDamage/BonusADRatio/APRatio scaled by ExtraHitReduction=0.25, as also embedded in MaxDamageTotal's formula.

MaxDamage rows equal the base [90,123.75,...,225], confirming base*(1+0.25*5). The scaling coefficients 1.2375 (bonusAd) and 0.45 (ap) are not printed directly as separate data rows: they equal BonusADRatio=0.55 and APRatio=0.2 each multiplied by the same (1+ExtraHitReduction*5)=2.25 factor embedded in MaxDamageTotal's formula (BaseDamage+ratio*stat, then plus that whole sum times 5 times ExtraHitReduction=0.25), which algebraically produces coef*(1+5*0.25)=coef*2.25.

MaxDamageEvolved rows equal the base [150,206.25,...,375], confirming base*(1+0.25*11). The scaling coefficients 2.0625 (bonusAd) and 0.75 (ap) are not printed directly as separate data rows: they equal BonusADRatio=0.55 and APRatio=0.2 each multiplied by the (1+ExtraHitReduction*11)=3.75 factor embedded in {b2bd0d2f}'s formula (BaseDamage+ratio*stat, then plus that whole sum times 11 times ExtraHitReduction=0.25), which algebraically produces coef*(1+11*0.25)=coef*3.75.

needsBespoke.why: Plasma's interaction across abilities needs bespoke ordering logic: Void Seeker applies 2-3 stacks 'as if applied successively' (each one dealing its own Caustic Wounds damage based on the stack count at that moment), and if it crosses the 5-stack detonation threshold mid-application, remaining stacks are reapplied afterward, with a specific damage-ordering rule (initial Caustic Wounds, then detonation, then Void Seeker's own bolt damage, then attack on-hit last if it's the trigger). No single closed-list primitive captures this multi-step successive-stack-application-with-interleaved-detonation behavior; it must be scripted as a small state machine around the target-stacks/execute-or-threshold primitives.

proposal: Assume Living Weapon evolutions are already active on all three basic abilities (sufficient items to meet AD/AP/AS thresholds), since evolutions strictly increase damage/utility and the fight is a fixed-loadout item build test.
Open with Void Seeker (W) to apply 2-3 Plasma stacks and deal its magic damage instance, using its low cast time before entering attack range.
Auto-attack continuously to build/refresh Plasma stacks (1 per hit) and trigger Caustic Wounds damage on each application, working toward and through the 5th-stack detonation repeatedly.
Cast Icathian Rain (Q) on cooldown for its 6 (or 12 evolved) missile hits of physical damage.

Cast Supercharge (E) as soon as available and off-cooldown-permitting, timing it so its post-charge attack-speed buff overlaps with the following auto-attack window, since each attack during that window also shaves 0.5s off Supercharge's own cooldown to bring it back sooner.
Recast Void Seeker (W) on cooldown for repeated magic damage plus Plasma reapplication/detonation.

Ignore Killer Instinct (R) in the damage fight except to leverage its attack-reset if it usefully realigns the next auto-attack, since its shield/dash are pure survivability with no target requirement satisfied on a stationary dummy that lacks Plasma persistence issues (dummy is 'affected by Plasma' via attacks, so R could be cast for the attack reset alone).

In the survival fight (Kai'Sa as the tank), only R's shield (and passively its cooldown-based reapplication) contributes to survivability; ignore Q/W/E for damage-taken purposes and use R defensively on cooldown to soak the enemy's rotation.
